subject: Private Offer pricing sync: channel passback evidence & SKU mapping
messages:
From: Dana Michaels <dana.michaels@bluecloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueCloud Sales Ops <sales-ops@bluecloud.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private Offer — clarification on passback evidence and SKU mapping

Hi Priya / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — BlueCloud is moving toward a pilot and procurement has a couple of tricky asks before we can approve the private offer in Marketplace:

- They need a clear mapping of SKU list prices to the private-offer bucketed discounts (we have 12 SKUs across compute/throughput).
- Channel passback: finance requires a documented flow showing how reseller/distributor credits cascade and whether list-price holdbacks apply. They want sample entries for month 1 and month 7.
- Evidence: SOC2 artefacts and a redacted billing statement that demonstrates prior passback mechanics. If you have a template or anonymized example that shows the audit trail, that would be ideal.

I attached the procurement checklist (bluecloud_po_requirements.pdf). Can you let us know what you can provide and an ETA? Procurement is targeting an internal approval on 10/22.

Appreciate it — Dana

[Attachment: bluecloud_po_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Michaels <dana.michaels@bluecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer — clarification on passback evidence and SKU mapping

Dana — thanks for the clear checklist. Pulling together the artifacts now. Quick update and asks: 

1) SKU mapping & buckets: Ben has drafted a pricing bucket matrix that shows list price (Marketplace SKU) -> private-offer unit price -> effective reseller net. I attached the draft (redwood_pricing_bucket_matrix.xlsx). We can produce two variants:
   - Variant A: flat % off per SKU family (simpler for Marketplace UI)
   - Variant B: tiered bucket where heavy-usage SKUs get steeper discounts (preferred for BlueCloud pilot economics).

2) Passback flow: We will produce a one-page diagram + example ledger entries for month 1 and month 7. That will show the passback waterfall (Marketplace list price -> Redwood gross -> reseller fee -> distributor holdback -> BlueCloud net).

3) Evidence: SOC2 report is available (summary) and we can provide a redacted billing snapshot from a prior Marketplace customer that shows a similar passback routing. That will be in supporting-passback-evidence.zip. Note: redaction will remove customer PII.

ETA: I can get the pricing matrix + passback ledger examples to you by 10/19 EOD; evidence package by 10/20. Does that timeline work for procurement?

Ben / Irene — looping you in for margin math and tax/treatment confirmation (see notes in the attached spreadsheet).

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

[Attachments: redwood_pricing_bucket_matrix.xlsx (xlsx), supporting-passback-evidence.zip (zip)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Dana Michaels <dana.michaels@bluecloud.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer — clarification on passback evidence and SKU mapping

Thanks Dana / Priya. I reviewed the procurement checklist and the draft matrix. A couple of things I added inline in the spreadsheet but summarizing here:

- Reseller fee treatment: We recommend expressing the reseller fee as a % of Redwood gross before distributor holdbacks. Example rows included: SKU-A list $0.10/unit -> Private-offer $0.06/unit -> Redwood gross $0.06 -> Reseller fee 10% ($0.006) -> Distributor holdback 2% of list (applied separately) -> BlueCloud net.
- Tax & GST: Irene, please confirm whether the distributor holdback should be modeled pre- or post-tax for BlueCloud's region; this affects the effective net.
- Month 7 example: I filled in an assumed uplift (20% usage growth) to show how absolute passback dollars change while % passback remains constant.

Attachments: updated spreadsheet with margin calc tab and a sample ledger row (one_line_ledger_example.csv).

Action items for procurement: if they want the Variant B tiering, we will need approximate usage distribution per SKU to choose bands — otherwise Variant A is quick to publish.

Ben
Director, Channel Deals, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: one_line_ledger_example.csv (csv)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Michaels <dana.michaels@bluecloud.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer — clarification on passback evidence and SKU mapping

Hi all — I reviewed Ben's margin calcs and the passback examples. A few compliance/tax notes: 

- Distributor holdbacks should be shown as an offset to Redwood gross (pre-tax) on the ledger we provide; procurement can see both pre- and post-tax net.
- For evidence, we'll include the SOC2 cover letter and the redacted billing snapshot. We will also include a short note describing our audit trail (how Marketplace events are recorded) for their finance team.
- DocuSign: once BlueCloud confirms which Variant (A/B) and the SKU bands, I'll approve the pricing table and we can create the private-offer in the chosen marketplace channel. I recommend Variant A for speed if procurement needs to close on 10/22.

Dana — attaching a brief note I wrote for procurement that explains tax handling and ledger column definitions. If this looks good, Priya, please send the combined package to procurement (attachments below) and include the HubSpot deal link.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Partner Finance, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: tax-passback-explain.docx (docx), supporting-passback-evidence.zip (updated)]
